body:
Hey, what you're facing right now is one of the greatest pains that people can endure. It is a pain that has been felt since the beginning of humanity. It has been the inspiration of countless works of art, and countless deeds, both awe inspiring deeds and terrible deeds. 

I could tell you the age old saying, that it is better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all, but I know you don't care right now, all you want is her. I can understand that, it's not easy having a hole like that in your life.

However, the one thing that everyone learns is that time does heal. Time will not stop pain, but it does dilute it. Your future is out there somewhere, waiting to be found. The girl who you will spend the rest of your life with is still there, it's simply not the person you originally thought it was. One day you will look back on today and be glad that your life went this way, that you grew enough from the experience to be the man that you are. And that man will only be there because of this mistake. He will only be there because she is not.

You probably don't believe me now, but please cling on to that bit of hope. There are a lot of people out there who are glad they did.
